name: cave-context
description: Unifies caveman + context-mode into one non-competing MCP server: vendors context-mode (Elastic License 2.0) and serves its ctx_* tools in-process, and aggregates both plugins' hooks.

branch_reindex.title: Auto-reindex on branch change
branch_reindex.description: Re-run ctx_index on the working directory when the git branch changes during a session (boolean, default true).
